content_html:
Inti Raymi is one of the most important celebrations in Peru and one of the most impressive cultural experiences you can enjoy in Cusco.

Every year, thousands of travelers arrive from around the world to witness this historical reenactment of the Inca Empire, filled with music, traditional clothing, and ancestral rituals.

Experience Inti Raymi Firsthand

https://www.facebook.com/reel/896165410119570

When Is Inti Raymi Celebrated?

Inti Raymi is celebrated every June 24 in the city of Cusco.

During this time, the city fills with culture, history, and visitors seeking a unique experience in South America.

What Is Inti Raymi?

Inti Raymi, or the “Festival of the Sun,” was an Inca ceremony dedicated to Inti, the Sun God, considered the most important deity of the Inca Empire.

Today, an impressive historical reenactment takes place at three main locations:

  • Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun)
  • Plaza de Armas de Cusco
  • Sacsayhuamán

How to Attend Inti Raymi

There are different ways to experience this event:

  • Attend independently (limited and with restrictions)
  • Book an organized tour (best option)

The most recommended option is through a tour, as it includes:

  • Transportation
  • Official tickets
  • Professional guide
  • Full organization

How Much Does Inti Raymi Cost?

Prices may vary depending on the type of experience and seat location.

Most packages generally include:

  • Event tickets
  • Internal transportation
  • Tour guide

Important: Availability is limited and tickets sell out in advance.

Why Experience Inti Raymi?

Because it is not just an event…

It is a direct connection to the history, culture, and energy of the ancient Inca Empire.

An experience that transforms your trip to Cusco into something unforgettable.
